I saved Ilse's note, Bay 30 for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from now on, as a private fact under her name. I confirmed it to her in your DM.

My first save went in as visible to the whole workspace by default. Since this came from a direct message, I saved it again as private and withdrew the first copy. Only the private one is live now. The memory tool keeps a history, so the withdrawn copy may still be in its records.

Memory search is running on exact words only. When she asks later, phrasing close to "Quarrendon" or "dock" will find it more reliably.
